books.desc: The weekly fund book (after red team and risk), held Thursday to Thursday. It traded the account until 14 Oct; from Protocol 7 (15 Oct) it is the shadow c0_weekly, tested against the lifecycle fund.
Analyst scores straight into the same sizing and risk rules, no red team.
Ridge model top and bottom 10 over the whole S&P 500, same risk rules (the primary benchmark).
Per-firm scores on the dashboard's 20 names, top and bottom 4 (Protocol 5).
10 long and 10 short drawn from the covered names, seeded by date (the luck baseline).
C2: the analyst prompt sampled 5 times at temperature 0.7; score = median, confidence from the spread.
C3: news only, with the firm's name, ticker and price facts masked.
C4: score x confidence / volatility, scaled to the fund's gross, each name at most 10%.
C5: the fund's views plus short-term reversal positions on covered names with no news.
C8: the analyst prompt plus the macro brief and each name's news neighbourhood, no red team.
C9: one call ranks C8's views; the champion's caps and hedge, N per side in the ranker's order.

Benchmark: just holding the S&P 500 (100% SPY, dividends reinvested), bought at the first execution day's close and never traded. Long only with full market exposure, unlike the hedged books, so it shows what the market did.
